args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1. KEY AGENTS:
  * SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - workforce skills analysis & training recommendations
  * PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator:v1
  * CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI, Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - KEY AGENTS FOR SAFETY ANALYSIS:
  * IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - ANALYZES SAFETY INCIDENTS & TRENDS - identifies root causes, recommends corrective/preventive actions, prioritized by risk severity
  * VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
  * IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1 - incident workflow coordination & emergency response
  * SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1 - compliance validation, incident prevention
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI, VendorInvoiceReconciliation
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY - NO create API
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - EquipmentOEEAnalytics, ProductionQualityMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM - KEY SUPPLIER/COMPLIANCE AGENTS:
  * SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 - automates vendor assessment & material qualification, monitors vendor compliance status, validates materials against specs
  * BOMComplianceValidator:v1 - validates BOMs against regulatory & supplier qualification requirements
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY FINDINGS:
- Safety incident analysis → sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
- Workforce capability assessment → SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1
- Supplier qualification & regulatory compliance verification → siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1

args.reason: This agent automates vendor assessment and material qualification workflows, monitors vendor compliance status, and orchestrates qualification reviews to ensure component sourcing meets regulatory requirements for qualified suppliers.
